verdict.rationale: Bulk processing of many items (for example, batch inference over many prompts) is a fair question for an inference engine, so the axis applies. However, the evidence documents no user-facing bulk or batch operation. Continuous batching is internal GPU scheduling of incoming requests, not a user capability to act on many items at once. The ScalarLM community report describes explicit batching added in a separate client, which is a user-side workaround and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
